cover.prompt: At the mercenary encampment at the foot of Mount Phyle, mercenary-1 in an ochre tunic and stiff linen corslet stands in an athletic wide contact stride beside a low stone drum, casting sheep knuckle-bones (astragaloi) with arm outstretched clear of his torso, elbows bent outward 25 degrees; opposite him mercenary-2 in deep blue stands with feet wide apart and spine arched in keen theatrical attention, watching the throw with palms open; a wooden tent pole and heavy draped linen flap frame the right margin as a foreground anchor; the rocky sunlit slope of Mount Phyle ascends diagonally across the mid-distance behind them, leaving clean contrast and ample air around their silhouettes, under a bright open sky.
cover.others: two more mercenaries seated in the distant camp by a fire tripod.
